source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 2 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 6.1 The system will reset immediately. 6.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Fatal Error - SWC: inject the DDR PMIC Fatal Error - SWC via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_Fatal_Error_-_SWC; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: Fatal Error - SWC — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Exercise the DDR5 PMIC SWC fatal fault on each applicable DIMM and voltage comparator, confirm the intended reset and a fresh SWC/railtype2-specific report, and verify the SWC rail, memory channel and management interface recover.
required_package: PMIC datasheet/register proof that railtype2 selects SWC and definitions of voltagetype0/1
Per-DIMM socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm and PMIC part/address topology
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller, bus, address, OOB path and expected SWC register response
Vendor-correct command continuation and full tuple-expansion matrix
SWC rail nominal/range, monitored status bits, current/temperature limits and hard aborts
Fresh railtype2 PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL evidence, reset/boot/training timeouts, memory recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Obtain the PMIC register map that binds SWC to railtype2 and voltage types; build a per-DIMM socket/die/UMC/slot/PMIC-address matrix; identify BMC/platform I2C ownership; record SWC telemetry/status baseline; inject one tuple under OOB observation; correlate exact rail status and persistent error; validate reset, training and memory; restore PMIC/I2C configuration before a separately approved next tuple.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.

test_case.recovery: The I2C path is platform-management scope under the Wistron rule. Require the controller/bus/address and vendor response; do not accept a host Linux bus listing. Keep SWC evidence separate from other rail-type cases even when reset behavior looks identical.

source_conflict.reason: All DIMMs and two voltage types are required, but only 0:0:3/dimm0/voltagetype0 is specified and no mapping rule exists. The split command is syntactically ambiguous. Railtype2-to-SWC, comparator meanings and I2C ownership are not proven, and acceptance lacks rail-specific electrical criteria.
